components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'

        schemaValidationErrors:

          type: array

            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:

        - detail
        - timestamp

    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS or
            DR). When supplied it is used to compose the owner's 'salutation';
            stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Optional: an owner may instead
            supply the structured 'addressLine1' (and optional 'addressLine2').
            When structured fields are present they are preferred; otherwise this
            flat value is accepted for backward compatibility. On read this is the
            composed, normalized address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with a
            single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Optional;
            preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied. Normalized like
            'address' (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common street-type
            abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. unit or suite). Normalized like 'address' and, when present,
            appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create, spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped and the number is converted to E.164 form: a
            leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits,
            which is the stored and returned value (e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes
            '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, as an ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' date.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's
            current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, as an ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' date. Optional;
            when supplied it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present.
            When supplied it must be valid for the owner's city per the fixed
            region table (Sydney/NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne/VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane/QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner
            already occupies the same household (i.e. shares the same last name
            and postcode, which is the computed 'householdId'). It only bypasses
            the household-duplicate block, marking the owner a declared household
            member; the exact identity-key duplicate check still applies.
            Write-only; never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as 'title lastName' (the title, a
                single space, then the last name) when a 'title' was supplied, or
                just the last name when no title was given.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61412345678' becomes '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone'
                stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global
                4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic household identifier: the first 12 hex characters
                of the SHA-256 digest of the owner's normalized last name and
                postcode ('normalizedLastName|postcode'). It is a pure function of
                those two values, so owners sharing a last name and postcode share
                it automatically, and it is assigned to every owner.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that already shared this owner's
                first name and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the
                moment this owner was created; the owner itself is not counted.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year
                (e.g. 'SMI-0007-M26').
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Starts at 0 and gains 2 when an
                email is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household of
                3 or more members, and 3 for tenure of more than 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3
                points, level 3 for 4-5 points, and level 4 for 6 or more
                points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              readOnly: true
              example: 2
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              readOnly: true
              example: 4
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, derived from city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived from the locality (region)
                using the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when
                the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration day at the moment it was created (a bulk
                sign-up surge), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' measured against
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64
                inclusive, and 'SENIOR' when 65 or over. Absent when no
                'birthDate' was supplied.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'ADULT'
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key used for duplicate detection, formatted
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where email and
                householdId are the empty string when absent. A create is
                rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole identityKey
                equals an existing owner's, so two members of the same household
                with different telephones have different keys and are both
                allowed. The householdId is always present (it is computed for
                every owner).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61412345678||a1b2c3d4e5f6'
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, while not a hard (identityKey) duplicate,
                shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode but has a
                different telephone (a soft match flagged for review), otherwise
                false. A declared household member (created with
                'sharesHousehold') is never flagged, since sharing a lastName and
                postcode is now exactly the household key.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches (same
                lastName and postcode, different telephone) when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true; absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false. DELETE /api/owners/{id} sets this true and retains the
                record; a deleted owner is still returned by GET but is ignored by
                the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
          required:
            - pets
            - deleted

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS or
            DR). When supplied it is used to compose the owner's 'salutation';
            stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Optional: an owner may instead
            supply the structured 'addressLine1' (and optional 'addressLine2').
            When structured fields are present they are preferred; otherwise this
            flat value is accepted for backward compatibility. On read this is the
            composed, normalized address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with a
            single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Optional;
            preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied. Normalized like
            'address' (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common street-type
            abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. unit or suite). Normalized like 'address' and, when present,
            appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create, spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped and the number is converted to E.164 form: a
            leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits,
            which is the stored and returned value (e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes
            '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, as an ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' date.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's
            current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, as an ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' date. Optional;
            when supplied it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present.
            When supplied it must be valid for the owner's city per the fixed
            region table (Sydney/NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne/VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane/QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner
            already occupies the same household (i.e. shares the same last name
            and postcode, which is the computed 'householdId'). It only bypasses
            the household-duplicate block, marking the owner a declared household
            member; the exact identity-key duplicate check still applies.
            Write-only; never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as 'title lastName' (the title, a
                single space, then the last name) when a 'title' was supplied, or
                just the last name when no title was given.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61412345678' becomes '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone'
                stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global
                4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic household identifier: the first 12 hex characters
                of the SHA-256 digest of the owner's normalized last name and
                postcode ('normalizedLastName|postcode'). It is a pure function of
                those two values, so owners sharing a last name and postcode share
                it automatically, and it is assigned to every owner.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that already shared this owner's
                first name and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the
                moment this owner was created; the owner itself is not counted.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>', derived from the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate. The fiscal year starts
                on 1 July, so a registration on or after 1 July belongs to that
                calendar year's fiscal year and an earlier one to the previous
                year's (e.g. a 2026-08-15 registration is 'FY26').
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY26'
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year (the same YY
                as fiscalYear) derived from the registrationDate
                (e.g. 'SMI-0007-M26').
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
